notes.title: Update Notes
notes.notes: Language Selection: Fixed issues with the language dropdown menu during the game build. Players can now smoothly select and play the game in their preferred language.

notes.title: Localization Update
notes.notes:
Dear Players,

We are excited to announce a new localization update for Döner Master Simulator! This update aims to reach a wider audience and provide a better experience for players who speak different languages. You can now personalize your gaming experience with support for the following languages:

English
Turkish
Spanish
Italian
Russian
German
Portuguese
Polish
French
With this update, the in-game texts, menus, and user interface have been made accessible in more languages. Our localization efforts have been carefully crafted to reflect the game's atmosphere and narrative as best as possible.

Our goal is to ensure that every player can enjoy the game in their preferred language. Please don’t forget to update and enjoy the game with these new language options!

Your feedback is invaluable to us. Feel free to share your thoughts on which languages should be supported further or any other suggestions you may have.

Happy gaming!
